title: 第17章 他长大了是么第18章 阴阳玄龙丹宁儿你来吃更合适
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
第17章他，长大了是么？苏婉卿的脸上并无娇羞之态，她很分得清楚轻重。
此刻弟子的告白，不论是出自何意，可一个愿意在她危难之时相扶，与她同生共死之人，答应了又如何！
她很了解楚宁，这番话说出，弟子就会负责！
有此依靠，她足够信任。
苏婉卿很快就是松开楚宁，盯着他的双眼。
“宁儿，为师问你，和江清悦交手之后，到底发生了什么？”
楚宁没有犹豫，当即就是说出了刚刚所发生的一切。
苏婉卿一愣，而后错愕至极的看向了楚宁！
江清悦，也是她教出来的弟子！
五十岁的三境巅峰修士，即将是要突破四境了。
飘渺剑诀第四层，战斗经验很足，居然是被楚宁打到昏死！
“你身上，伤势如何.......”
楚宁笑着摇了摇头，仍是握着苏婉卿的手。
“弟子无碍，那长春之意可修复师尊伤势，也可修复弟子的。”
但不能说是完全无碍，至少需要一点时间恢复，只是不影响此刻的行动。
苏婉卿面色复杂，望着面前的楚宁，已经不知道要说些什么了。
他的成长，快到自己都看不清，看不见。
如今竟已经能击溃江清悦了，未来必然是不输给她的剑道天骄！
此等修士，苏婉卿如何可能还留在这里，能走必然先是离开！
但苏婉卿很快是察觉到了不对劲。

“按理说来，这几乎是他们能把我们师徒二人钉死，然后光明正大踢出小竹峰的机会了，他们居然没半点动静？”
不对，绝对不会，宗门之人难道是迷途知返了？
可他们绝非是这种人，绝对是因为什么！
此刻的楚宁立刻询问道：“师尊，江清悦来找师尊证明清白，到底是为了什么？”
苏婉卿摇头。
“为师判断，可能是为师的储物戒，但那东西连为师如今都打不开，即便是宗主陈玄天来了，强行破坏，只会让储物戒内的一切全部烟消云散，应该不会是这个。”
“对方既然对我们有所图谋，但如今这么好的机会居然这么都不错，此事也太过蹊跷了........”
苏婉卿如此想着，可目光落在了一脸疑惑的楚宁身上的时候，微微一愣。
不对，她好像想到了！
“宗门之人，没人知道你的境界对吧，至少在此之前，没一个人！”
苏婉卿恍然大悟一般！
“为师懂了，你如今三境修为，力战五十岁的江清悦甚至还能胜过，宗门之人绝对怀疑你身上有什么，或者说，他们怀疑，你身上，有为师给的什么！”
“如此这般，就能解释江清悦为什么还会来找为师，因为她要接近得到这东西，但他们根本不知道，为师没有这些，而有这些的只有宁儿你！”
此刻，苏婉卿脸色又是难看至极，攥紧拳头冷笑一声。
“这般弟子，果真是令人寒心，但为师如今什么都没有了，也没资格说什么，倘若修为再回，为师第一个杀的，就是她！”
助纣为虐，里应外合，想要欺骗苏婉卿身上的传承！
就算是有，她也不可能拿出来半点！
如今，苏婉卿所信任的唯独只有楚宁！
听到这番话的楚宁一声卧槽！
难怪那个江清悦会来！

感情是宗门之内觉得苏婉卿还有后手！
content_en:
Chapter 17 He has grown up, right? There was no shyness on Su Wanqing's face, she clearly understood the importance.
No matter what the disciple's confession at this moment is, it doesn't matter if a person who is willing to support her in times of crisis and live and die with her agrees!
She knows Chu Ning very well, and if she says these words, her disciple will be responsible!
She has enough trust to rely on him.
Su Wanqing quickly let go of Chu Ning and stared into his eyes.
"Ning'er, I want to ask you, my teacher, what happened after the fight with Jiang Qingyue?"
Chu Ning did not hesitate and immediately told what had just happened.
Su Wanqing was stunned for a moment, and then looked at Chu Ning in astonishment!
Jiang Qingyue is also a disciple she taught!
The fifty-year-old monk at the peak of the Third Realm is about to break through to the Fourth Realm.
The fourth level of the Piaomiao Sword Technique, with a lot of combat experience, was actually beaten to death by Chu Ning!
"How are your injuries..."
Chu Ning smiled and shook her head, still holding Su Wanqing's hand.
"Disciple is fine. The eternal spring spirit can repair the master's injuries, and it can also repair the disciple's."
But it cannot be said that it is completely harmless. At least it will take some time to recover, but it will not affect the current actions.
Su Wanqing's face was complicated. She looked at Chu Ning in front of her and didn't know what to say.
He was growing so fast that he couldn't even see clearly.
Now that she has been able to defeat Jiang Qingyue, she will definitely be a prodigy in swordsmanship who will not lose to her in the future!
How could Su Wanqing, a monk like this, still stay here? She must leave first if she can!
But Su Wanqing quickly noticed something was wrong.
"Logically speaking, this is almost a chance for them to nail our master and apprentice to death, and then kick them out of Xiaozhu Peak in a fair and just way. Why don't they make any move?"
No, absolutely not. Could it be that the people of the sect have returned from their lost ways?
But they are definitely not this kind of people, definitely for some reason!
At this moment, Chu Ning immediately asked: "Master, why did Jiang Qingyue come to Master to prove his innocence?"
Su Wanqing shook her head.
"I judge that it may be my storage ring, but even I can't open that thing now. Even if the sect master Chen Xuantian comes and forcibly destroys it, everything in the storage ring will disappear. This should not be the case."
"Since the other party has plans for us, but now such a good opportunity is so good, this matter is too strange..."
Su Wanqing thought so, but when her eyes fell on Chu Ning, who looked confused, she was slightly stunned.
No, she seems to have thought of it!
"No one in the sect knows your realm, right? At least before this, no one!"
Su Wanqing suddenly realized it!
"Master, I understand. With your current level of cultivation in the Three Realms, you can even defeat the fifty-year-old Jiang Qingyue. The people in the sect definitely doubt that there is something in you, or in other words, they suspect that there is something in you that was given to you by Master!"
"In this way, it can explain why Jiang Qingyue still comes to see me, because she wants to get this thing, but they don't know at all that me doesn't have these things, and the only one who has these things, Ning'er!"
At this moment, Su Wanqing's face was extremely ugly, she clenched her fists and sneered.
"Such a disciple is really chilling, but now that my master has nothing, I have no right to say anything. If I return to my cultivation level, the first one I will kill will be her!"
Helping the emperor to do evil, cooperating inside and outside, trying to deceive Su Wanqing's inheritance!
Even if there was, she wouldn't be able to take out any of it!
Now, the only one Su Wanqing trusts is Chu Ning!
After hearing these words, Chu Ning screamed, "F*ck!"
No wonder that Jiang Qingyue came!
The feeling is that the sect feels that Su Wanqing has a back-up plan!
